ideas.pitch: A quantum variational eigensolver that optimizes multi-asset financial portfolios using Qiskit and classical heuristic feedback.
ideas.problem_statement: Quantum machine learning and optimization problem statement for asset allocation.
ideas.title: Qiskit VQE Portfolio Optimizer

ideas.problem_statement: Quantum error correction and fault tolerance challenge statement.
ideas.title: Quantum Error Correction Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Educational and visual tools score exceptionally well with hackathon judges because they make abstract quantum mechanics immediately demonstrable.

ideas.title: Hybrid QML Molecular Property Predictor

ideas.title: Qiskit Grover Pathfinder
